messages.content:
Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a current registration record for Kibo. Include the issuing authority's effective dates, the matching Cherrywood property-file status, and whether any duplicate packet or additional document is still required.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Kibo Current Registration Record — 2028-01-01", "body": "Kibo current registration record

Record date: January 1, 2028

Issuing authority
- Registration status: Renewed registration issued
- Effective dates: June 16, 2027 through June 15, 2028

Cherrywood property file
- Status: Current
- File registration valid through: June 15, 2028
- The issued registration has been uploaded to the property file.

Outstanding requirements
- Duplicate registration packet: Not required
- Additional document: Not required
- Interim-proof matter and authority review: Resolved"}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_003_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The record says Kibo's registration was issued for June 16, 2027 through June 15, 2028, no duplicate packet or additional document is required, and Cherrywood marks the property-file registration current through June 15, 2028.", "value": {"title": "Kibo Current Registration Record — 2028-01-01", "body": "Kibo current registration record

Record date: January 1, 2028

Issuing authority
- Registration status: Renewed registration issued
- Effective dates: June 16, 2027 through June 15, 2028

Cherrywood property file
- Status: Current
- File registration valid through: June 15, 2028
- The issued registration has been uploaded to the property file.

Outstanding requirements
- Duplicate registration packet: Not required
- Additional document: Not required
- Interim-proof matter and authority review: Resolved"}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_003_01","passed":true,"reason":"The body states “Renewed registration issued,” with “Effective dates: June 16, 2027 through June 15, 2028”; the Cherrywood property file is “Current” and “valid through: June 15, 2028”; and both “Duplicate registration packet” and “Additional document” are “Not required.”"}]}
